spindle.observe.RequestClass.title: RequestClass
spindle.observe.RequestClass.description: How a served run answered one request. `served`: the model answered it, with any outcome the command declares, or the view's rows. `refused`: the ingress or ESS's standard refusal answered it `4xx` before the model did, other than `not-granted`. `not-granted`: `403` "not granted", no grant admits the actor. `not-served`: `501`, the operation is one this ingress cannot route, the kernel does not run or the host does not read, or an external cause nothing answered. `failed`: any other `5xx`. `unrouted`: no route has the path, or not under that method.
